name: Kusanagi Nene
source:
Nene is a foul-mouthed girl who was recommended by [url=/c123755]Rui[/url] to join the troupe. With dreams of singing onstage for a musical, her singing ability is almost too good to be that of a high school girl. However, whenever she's around [url=/c123756]Tsukasa[/url] and [url=/c123757]Emu[/url], instead of appearing onstage herself, she operates her Nene-Robo and performs through it.

She's part of the musical show unit Wonderlands×Showtime.

[From in-game profile]
